newsitem.title: JAPAN: U.S. Treasuries closed in Tokyo for holiday.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Treasuries closed in Tokyo for holiday.

text.p: The U.S. Treasury bond market is closed in Tokyo on Monday for the Labour Day holiday in the United States. Trading will resume on Tuesday.
On Friday in New York, the key 30-year bond ended sharply lower as fears of a Fed credit tightening surfaced after the release of a new batch of stronger-than-expected economic data.

The 6-3/4 percent benchmark 30-year U.S. Treasury bond ended down 30/32 at 95-14/32. The yield jumped to 7.12 percent, the highest mark in almost seven weeks. It closed at 7.04 percent in New York on Thursday.
